description: Defines a utility class 'DisposableSet' for managing a collection of Disposable objects from RxJava, allowing batch disposal of resources.

classes.name: DisposableSet
classes.description: A utility class to manage a set of Disposable objects, allowing adding disposables and disposing all at once.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a Disposable to the set for management.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes all Disposable objects in the set and clears the collection.
